concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-account-pass-through-payout]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Adyen guide to pass-through merchant settlement: scheme/method receipt assigns sales to payable batches, one sales day can span batches, adjustments join as they occur and currency-specific bank holidays delay timing; batch assignment is not bank receipt.
warnings: This is merchant-sales settlement, not recipient Payout API behavior; the January 1–7 illustration, payout-frequency reference and holiday delays do not guarantee a live payout date.
